name: Sarita Pradhan / ସରିତା ପ୍ରଧାନ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sarita Pradhan is an Odia poet based in Cuttack. Her contributor note records postgraduate study in Odia and a published poetry collection. In the poem gathered here, concern for home extends beyond national boundaries to people displaced by war.

“ଦେଶ କଥା” begins with the familiar gestures of patriotism: a flag, applause and the national anthem. The eyes of a young refugee unsettle that assurance. Memories of school, a sister and food promised by a mother make the loss of a country intimate. The closing image widens the grief to a wounded earth, setting destruction against flowers, birds and the remembered fragrance of soil.
